newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat slips nearly two pct in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Fiat slips nearly two pct in Milan.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat fell around two percent on the Milan stock market shortly after the opening after Prime Minister Romano Prodi dashed market hopes of government help for the car sector.
Fiat was 1.93 percent down at 4360 by 0940 GMT while the blue-chip Mib30 index was 0.44 percent up on the day at 15480.
"This idea of incentives for the car sector is one the market has been thinking about for a while," one trader said.
Prodi said he did not believe special financial incentives were the best way to revive flagging car sales in Italy.
